newsitem.title: USA: Sci Systems gets computer pact.
newsitem.headline: Sci Systems gets computer pact.

text.p: SCI Systems said Tuesday it had been awarded a $162 million multi-year contract by McDonnell Douglas Corp's McDonnell Douglas Helicopter unit.

Under the pact, SCI will supply the main system computers, the weapons computers and the digital inter-communications systems for the upgrade of 343 AH-64A Apache aircraft to the AH-64D configuration for the U.S. Army and for 93 new AH-64D aircraft for Britain and the Netherlands.
SCI said the helicopter upgrade consists of improved target acquisition systems, crewstations and electronics.
The contract has a potential value of over $500 million when the total U.S. Army fleet upgrade and additional foreign sales are considered, SCI said.
